text: The bug is clear: the docstring promises that "whitespace around the word is ignored," but `parse_flag` only lowercases and doesn't strip. So `"off "` (with a trailing space) doesn't match `"off"` and ends up being evaluated as `True`. The fix is to strip before matching (this also makes the empty check correctly handle whitespace-only input).
